note: 2026-11-14 jit-time-1114 (PREPARED, NOT RUN): stage 2 of the paired JIT timing (docs/handoff/jit-paired-timing.md) on the merged build game-copy/ts3native.asi.jittimetable-1114 (branch feature/monojit-time-table, 0.36.259 = monojit-paired-timing + monojit-table-grow). 3 verify sessions of 15 min, BP / IP / SV: Mode=2 + Time=1 + Count=1, MaxMethods=8192, CodeKB=12288, rest = JIT bundle ON set (jit-bundle-verify-1113 ini). Correctness-class, not timing: no noise check, no ms/s comparison with other queues. First job stops the queue on FAIL. Run: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/jit-time-1114.json --no-smoke. ~3 x 18 min. Then read each job: node tools/jit-time.ts <job>/ts3native.log --csv docs/data/jit-time-1114-<world>.

jobs.pinReason: jittimetable-1114 pair (builds.json, branch feature/monojit-time-table): same asi and ts3fixes package (release package rc1111e) in all three worlds; a ts3native rebuild between jobs would void the pair
jobs.note: jit-time-1114 stage 2 (docs/handoff/jit-paired-timing.md), BP, 15 min. Correctness-class verify session: Mode=2 (one call in 16 per method run compiled, then re-run in EA's interpreter and compared) with Time=1 (rdtsc around both passes) and Count=1; do not compare its ms/s with any timing queue (Mode=2 doubles the compiled work). JIT bundle ON set (jit-bundle-ab-1113 ON arm) with MaxMethods=8192 and CodeKB=12288 (table-grow: ~5.5k Mode=1 bodies x ~1.7 KB = ~9.4 MB; Mode=2 bodies ~2.1 KB = ~11.5 MB, tight: a full region (jitFullN > 0) is a finding, rerun with CodeKB=16384). Pass: no crash, script errors 0, jitMismatch 0, jitFaults 0, jitTableFull <= 10 (table-grow target 0), a 'jittime: end' block. Read: node tools/jit-time.ts <job>/ts3native.log --csv docs/data/jit-time-1114-bp, then --stub-cycles 0 for the upper bound; also jitMethods (end), jitFullN, jitCodeKB. Not forced: a 'save' block (profile runs have no save step; the 10-min interval and exit blocks are enough). One MISMATCH line = a compiler bug: stop, triage.

jobs.note: jit-time-1114 stage 2 (docs/handoff/jit-paired-timing.md), SV, 15 min. Correctness-class verify session: Mode=2 (one call in 16 per method run compiled, then re-run in EA's interpreter and compared) with Time=1 (rdtsc around both passes) and Count=1; do not compare its ms/s with any timing queue (Mode=2 doubles the compiled work). JIT bundle ON set (jit-bundle-ab-1113 ON arm) with MaxMethods=8192 and CodeKB=12288 (table-grow: ~5.5k Mode=1 bodies x ~1.7 KB = ~9.4 MB; Mode=2 bodies ~2.1 KB = ~11.5 MB, tight: a full region (jitFullN > 0) is a finding, rerun with CodeKB=16384). Pass: no crash, script errors 0, jitMismatch 0, jitFaults 0, jitTableFull <= 10 (table-grow target 0), a 'jittime: end' block. Read: node tools/jit-time.ts <job>/ts3native.log --csv docs/data/jit-time-1114-sv, then --stub-cycles 0 for the upper bound; also jitMethods (end), jitFullN, jitCodeKB. Not forced: a 'save' block (profile runs have no save step; the 10-min interval and exit blocks are enough). One MISMATCH line = a compiler bug: stop, triage.
